_comment: THUGPRO compatibility for the THPS4 level ports (tools/thps4_levels). Each entry is registered in README.md here (TP-20 ... TP-29). Online a level is known only by its load script's checksum (messages 0x46 / 0x33): these make our level structures agree with THUGPRO's own THPS4 ports where THPS4's own names can't; TP-22 ... TP-29 are THUGPRO's hand edits of its ports (thps4_levels/thugpro_edits.ts). Read by tools/compat/compat.ts; `thps4_levels.ts convert --compat none` leaves all of it out.

net_nodes._source: THUGPRO's installed data\pre\<level>_scripts.prx node arrays, extracted by `node tools/thps4_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro` (places only: pos = THUG2's Pos axes)

node_moves._source: THUGPRO's installed data\pre\<level>_scripts.prx / <level>col.prx against THPS4's own Game\data\levels files, extracted by `node tools/thps4_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro` (thugpro_edits.ts; pos = THUG2's Pos axes)

_not_applied._note: What --extract-thugpro saw and did not take (not node data, or the toolchain's own translation): listed for the user (README.md, docs/pending/thps4-thugpro.md); nothing reads it
Alc: collision not compared: levels\alc\alc.col.xbx: read of 91816 bytes at 0x125C04 past the end (0x13BBF8)

door_walls._note: THUGPRO keeps THPS4's invisible door walls of the skate shop (InvisColl01's shop side, Object10's two invisible faces); ours opens the door (the user's request, 2026-10-19: port_changes PC-THPS4-1 / PC-THPS4-2). Off: enabled true keeps the walls as THUGPRO's

port_changes._note: This project's own changes to THPS4's levels - neither THPS4's data nor THUGPRO's. Applied whatever --compat says (they are not THUGPRO data: --compat none keeps them); thps4_levels.ts convert --no-port-changes leaves out all but the required ones (THPS4's data as it is, but what a level needs to load or install). Each entry: id, op (add / set / remove), rule (the converter step that applies it: thps4_levels.portChanges), target (target.level or target.levels: a list or "*"), why, required (true: a level needs it to load / make_menu_level needs it - kept with --no-port-changes). A "set" on something the level hasn't is an error the converter reports, never an add.

entries.why: The skate shop's door open (the user, 2026-10-19; our main menu's backdrop): InvisColl01's shop-side face (its z-min plane, across the door) left out; its z-max face (the fence's gap) kept
The skate shop's door open (as PC-THPS4-1): the shop's own two invisible faces across the doorway (THPS4's face flag 0x1000, x 699-777 at z -1074) left out
The fence piece at the end of the halfpipe there at the start (the user, 2026-10-19: a gap there): THPS4's menu killed it and its practice run created it again

target.nodes: the walkers and Car_Generic01 cars peds_cars.ts makes

entries.why: Crash guard: with College's walker and car its node array came out null in the game (a crash loading; cause not found)
Crash guard: THUG2's script vector pool is fixed (9500 for every script's); College's node array with them didn't fit and came out null. Zero Angles are the default: nothing changes in play

target.nodes: made objects not there at the start that no brought script creates, waypoints no path or script uses

entries.why: Crash guard: THUG2's script heap didn't hold College's node array with all of them (it came out null); they are goals' pieces nothing of ours creates

target.where: LevelGeometry nodes without a scene sector

entries.why: Crash guard: ParseNodeArray (0x00588630) registers a TrickObject's sector without checking it is there (nodes.stripMissingTrickObjects)
THPS4's goals, career, cameras and panels aren't ported: their commands left out of the scripts brought along (besides script_port's own list, shared by every port), although THUG2 has them

target.scripts: a restart's trigger script with no statement left (and the script)

entries.why: THPS4's menu restart's script (FreezeSkater, its camera) has nothing left once translated; an empty script also broke make_menu_level's script parsing

target.nodes: restarts over nothing or over a kill zone

entries.why: Not network spawns and not kill targets (nodes.groundRestarts against the written collision): a player put there would fall forever or die again

target.nodes: path followers, peds and cars (AbsentInNetGames); single-player levels' Player1 restarts (Multiplayer, Horse)

entries.why: Network games have no path manager or ped animations, and need restarts for the players (nodes.netGameNodes)

target.where: objects whose TriggerScript sets its model's lights (Obj_EnableAmbientLight, Obj_SetLightAmbientColor...: Carnival's and London's Mdl_NoDynLighting)

entries.why: Crash guard: THUG2's model light members (0x00421AE0) read through the model's lights, which only UseModelLights makes (0x004214F0) - Carnival crashed loading at 0x0048DE30 (nodes.useModelLights)

target.where: LevelObjects / GameObjects whose TriggerScript plays a stream on them, through THUG2's scripts too (the trams' Car_Generic01: SpawnSound Auto_SFX_Car_Tire_Squeal)

entries.why: Crash guard: the stream members run on the object's stream component, which a LevelObject only has with SupportStreams (gameobj_add_components) - Alcatraz and San Francisco crashed when a tram braked for the skater (nodes.supportStreams)

target.nodes: every node kind's common fields (all but Pos / Position / Angles / Name / Links / TriggerScript) as global structures the nodes name, <level>_inc_<n> - the converter's last step on the level's .qb (nodes.shareNodeFields), after every pass that reads nodes' own fields

entries.why: node fields shared the way THUG2's own levels do (ncomp_*), so big levels fit the script component pool

thugpro_new._register: TPN-THPS4-1 ... TPN-THPS4-5 (README.md here: "New in THUGPRO (not in any source game)")
thugpro_new._source: THUGPRO's installed data\pre\<level>_scripts.prx (its level files: <level>.qb, <level>_scripts.qb, <level>_thugpro.qb, models) against THPS4's own Game\data\levels files, extracted by `node tools/thps4_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro` (thugpro_new.ts)
thugpro_new._note: THUGPRO's own content, in no source game - by reference only: `files` name THUGPRO's archive, the entry, its size and SHA-256; the converter reads the bytes from the user's install (--thugpro) and leaves a level's content out with a warning when the install or a file differs. --compat none and --no-thugpro-new leave all of it out; models (shown_by_thugpro false: THUGPRO's shipped scripts don't place them) only with --thugpro-banners
